goal.en: You have saved R1,200 of R6,000 for Frosty. At R115 a week you will get there in about 42 weeks. Saving a little more each week gets you there sooner.
goal.zu: Ugcine u-R1,200 kwezingu-R6,000 ze-Frosty. Ngo-R115 ngesonto uzofika ngemva kwamasonto angaba ngu-42. Ukugcina okwengeziwe kukufikisa masinyane.

family.en: Supporting your family matters. Try the simulator to see how sending R500 home changes your Frosty date, then decide what feels right.
family.zu: Ukusiza umndeni wakho kubalulekile. Zama i-simulator ubone ukuthi ukuthumela u-R500 ekhaya kuyishintsha kanjani idethi ye-Frosty.

save.en: Your Safe to Save amount is R2,200 this month, and R500 is a comfortable start. Even R100 a week adds up.
save.zu: Imali ongayigcina ngokuphepha le nyanga ngu-R2,200, futhi u-R500 uyisiqalo esihle. Noma u-R100 ngesonto uyakhula.

default.en: I can help with your goals, savings and sending money home. Try asking how close you are to Frosty.
default.zu: Ngingakusiza ngezinjongo zakho, ukonga nokuthumela imali ekhaya. Zama ukubuza ukuthi usondele kangakanani ku-Frosty.
